text:
Priya: Hey team, partner asked for a single-run checklist we can use when we spin up a joint demo tenant. need to cover SSO, SCIM, egress billing split, telemetry hooks, and an emergency rollback plan.
Leo: can you share the partner's template? want to avoid duplicating asks.
Dana: pasted the key bullets from partner: 
- tenant per-customer?
- who pays for egress + storage
- retention windows (logs, telemetry, embeddings)
- KMS or bring-your-own-key
- fallback model policy + QA acceptance
Carlos: ops note 4: per our infra model, tenant-per-customer requires a dedicated tenant for the partner (extra infra + entitlement). egress billing defaults to request origin account unless we host traffic in Redwood-managed tenant.
Priya: partner explicitly prefers partner-billed egress. how big is the delta? Carlos: rough calc: for a PoC with 50k requests/day ~ 40GB egress/day -> ~ $X/day on standard cloud egress. if Redwood hosts, partner pays Redwood's egress invoice or we net it into their reserved commit.
Dana: security asks: they require SCIM for user sync, SAML SSO with signed assertions, and an option for customer-managed KMS. blockers: we currently support KMS via API but not full BYOK HSM attestation.
Leo: can we give them a timeline for BYOK HSM certs? that's likely an enterprise blocker.
Carlos: BYOK HSM integration is a 3-4 week engineering project + legal review for key op controls. we can offer a mitigated path: Redwood-managed KMS with strict key rotation + CT logs, until BYOK path is live.
entitlement-bot: Quota check: partner org "edge-syndicate" allowed 100k monthly test tokens, no dedicated pools provisioned.
Priya: add fallback approval to checklist: partner must sign-off on fallback model variant and acceptable latency thresholds.
Dana: telemetry: partner wants near-real-time webhooks + daily batch export. need to confirm schema and retention (they want 90d for usage, 365d for audit logs).
Carlos: storage cost for 365d audit logs is non-trivial; propose two tiers: standard (90d) and enterprise (365d, extra $). Dana: noted. I'll draft cost bands.
Leo: pricing ask: partner wants 3 scenarios (trial 5k/day, steady 25k/day, enterprise 120k/day). can ops/infra produce recommended Dedicated sizing + estimated monthly cost?
Carlos: yes. I'll put together a sizing table and include assumptions (avg tokens/request, model family, KV cache enabled?). KV cache + batching assumptions change compute cost by ~30%.
Priya: sec questionnaire: partner also requested recent pen-test summary and subprocessors list. Legal wants SOC2 + any FedRAMP status?
Dana: we have SOC2 link and pen-test summary (redacted). no FedRAMP. adding both to the packet.
Leo: we should prepare a 1-pager heatmap before the partner call: columns = requirement, owner, time-to-resolution, blocker. aim to share 2 hours before call.
Priya: timeline: produce heatmap + cost bands + security packet by 5pm PT. I'll schedule the 45m call for tomorrow with partner security + their infra lead.
Carlos: FYI: if they want staging burst vs production reserved capacity we need a signed MSA for production reserved within 2 weeks or we can't guarantee sizing.
Dana: adding MSA ask to heatmap. also adding checkbox for "accept telemetry schema".
Priya: thanks all. small action list: Carlos -> sizing + egress delta; Dana -> security packet + pen-test link; Leo -> heatmap slide; I'll book the call once slides are ready. :thumbsup:
